name: Is my PDF or password uploaded anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Password removal happens entirely in your browser using QPDF (WebAssembly). Neither your file nor your password is sent to any server.

name: Can this recover or crack a password I don't know?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You must know the PDF's correct password. PDFree removes protection from files you're already authorized to open — it does not guess, recover, or bypass unknown passwords.

name: What if my PDF says "no password needed"?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some PDFs only have owner-level restrictions (like disabled printing or copying) with no password required to open them. PDFree detects this automatically and lets you remove those restrictions without typing anything.

name: I entered the password but it says incorrect. What now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Double-check for typos, extra spaces, or caps lock. Passwords are case-sensitive. Your file stays selected, so you can simply try again.

name: Is this a free PDF password remover with no sign up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is completely free — no sign up, no account, no installation. Open the tool, enter the password, and download the unlocked PDF.

name: Can I re-add a password later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — use Protect PDF to add a new password or restrictions to the unlocked file.
